ingredients.name: corn kernels, removed from the cob
bell pepper, green or red, chopped

steps.instruction: Melt 1 tablespoon of butter in a pot.
Add 1/2 cup of dried sea kelp and cook until it begins to dissolve in the butter.
Add 1 quart of corn kernels and 1 chopped bell pepper.
Add 2 cups of milk or cream and 2 cups of water.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Turn the heat to low and cover the pot.

steps.spoken: Simmer for 30 to 40 minutes, until the vegetables are soft.

steps.instruction: Take off the cover and cook on low until most of the liquid has cooked away.
